distinctions: The domain declaration is independent of native support and content availability, BECAUSE its support closure uses only the record, source restriction and declared schema.
Each role's THIS x WHAT agrees on the identical member restriction. Whole PROPOSE, DECIDE and PROMOTE records are not compared as one object.

Native IF_THEN records a contacted construction; it is not field NO, receipt THIS or a content hash renamed as a verdict.
